title: Career Roadmap · Electronics Mechanic
summary: An Electronics Mechanic installs, tests, troubleshoots and repairs electronic equipment, circuit boards, instruments and control systems across consumer, industrial and service sectors.

blocks.label: Recommended
blocks.text: Class 10 with Mathematics and Science for the ITI route.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Physics and Mathematics is useful for diploma and degree alternatives.

blocks.label: Explore

blocks.text: Fault isolation, digital electronics, sensors and microcontroller basics.

blocks.label: Common requirements
blocks.text: Academic transcripts, English or other language proficiency where applicable, subject prerequisites, and program-specific practical or academic criteria. Course availability and international eligibility must be checked on official institution websites.
